counting_contract.human_checkpoint: One included human:guided or human:confirm step.
counting_contract.paid_operation: One intentionally requested subject-under-test model completion.
counting_contract.panel: Count each worker completion and any separately prompted managed-session turn.
counting_contract.multi_round: Count every worker completion in every round.
counting_contract.managed_session: Count every prompted turn; launching and exiting without a prompt counts zero.
counting_contract.codex_verify_enrollment: Count one only when the command runs its empirical Codex turn.
counting_contract.ai_curated_transfer: Count one when external curation runs; deterministic fallback counts zero.
counting_contract.driver: Exclude the Claude-hosted checklist driver and report it separately.
